 1. This is a market survey for a construction project titled: Thomas P. Stafford Building (TPS) Restroom Upgrades at the Mike Monroney Aeronautical Center (MMAC), Oklahoma City, OK. 

 2. The Magnitude of Construction is between $5,000,000 and $10,000,000. Performance and payment bonds will be required in a penal sum equal to 100% of the contract price. 

 The Thomas P. Stafford Building (TPS) at the MMAC is a 222,130 gross square foot building originally constructed in 1991 and is comprised of a basement and two floors above grade.  The Thomas P. Stafford Building (Building 27) at the Mike Monroney Aeronautical Center (MMAC) in Oklahoma City functions as a state-of-the-art training complex. It houses the FAA Academy, providing advanced classrooms and simulation laboratories for air traffic control and Technical Operations students and instructors. This project will upgrade the restrooms to meet ADA compliance and will also include upgrades to the corridor finishes.  Work associated with construction of this project will be done primarily after hours (Midnight 12:00 am to 6:00 am Monday through Friday) and weekends to prevent disturbance to classes while the building is occupied.  The building is fully occupied and runs two shifts of classes from 6:00am to midnight 12:00am Monday through Friday. 

 The work required for the facility will include the following: 

 Provide all labor, equipment, and material to renovate all restrooms on all floors and to upgrade common area finishes in the Thomas P. Stafford building.  Requirements will be detailed in the construction plans and specifications provided by the FAA. The project includes: 

 
	  Architectural Restroom Scope: 

	 
		  Replace finishes and fixtures in bathrooms on all floors. Replace wall tile, countertops, sinks, faucets, partitions, paint ceilings and doors, new door push plates and kick plates.  Provide temporary trailer restrooms to maintain current fixture counts during renovation of restrooms. Only one Men’s and one Women’s restroom in the facility shall be under construction at a time. ADA automatic door openers are to be protected during construction and/or re-installed and operational after renovation at restrooms in which they occur. 
	 
	 
 

  

 
	  Mechanical Restroom Scope: 

	 
		 Replace supply diffusers and exhaust grilles in restrooms. 
	 
	 
 

  

 
	  Fire Sprinkler Scope: 

	 
		 Modify fire sprinklers as required. 
	 
	 
 

  

 
	  Electrical Restroom Scope: 

	 
		 Provide the electrical effort required to upgrade/replace the Lighting and Lighting Controls as part of the coordinated Restroom Upgrades. LD lighting shall be used for both general lighting and egress lighting with footcandle illumination levels meeting both Life Safety required code levels and IES recommended target design levels. 
	 
	 
 

  

 
	  Architectural Finishes in Common Circulation Areas Scope: 

	 
		 Demo and replace millwork in the Snack Bar area on the first floor. 
		 Replace the flooring in the café. This work will take place after café hours. Flooring replacement to be accomplished over a long weekend and be ready for business opening the following week or at least be in a state to allow normal and sanitary operations of the café to continue until work is complete. 
		 Corridor walls to full height and gypsum wall board ceilings to receive new high traffic quality paint. The new finish will be applied over the existing Zolatone wall finish and above the existing wall wainscot. Accent color wall paint will be applied to areas as designated in floor plans. Painting can only occur starting Friday at midnight 12:00am but must stop by Saturday at midnight 12:00am (24 hour timeframe) to allow paint odors to dissipate on Sunday.  Contractor to provide fans for ventilation to run until Sunday night. 
		 Remove circular signage at all doors and paint doors and door frames both sides. Replace with ABA/ANSI A117.1 compliant signage next to doors. 
		 Replace walk-off grating at all entrances to the building with walk-off carpeting. 
		 VCT (Vinyl Composite Tile) at corridor alcoves to be replaced. 
		 Paint all door frames and window framing gray color in place of purple. Painting both sides will require coordination with user groups and will need to be after hours work due to class schedules. 
		 Replace stair treads at four exterior staircases, new treads to include an abrasive edge to closely match what is installed at interior atrium staircases. 
	 
	 
 

 3. The purpose of this market survey is to solicit statements of interest and capabilities from small businesses, to include applicable small business socio-economic status, capable of providing the required construction services as well as to determine whether adequate competition exists to set-aside the competition among small businesses, to include applicable small business socio-economic status.  

 The NAICS code applicable to this requirement is 236220 Commercial and Institutional Building Construction. The business size standard for this NAICS is $45.0 million.
